Country/Region of Origin: Europe
Time Period: Early 1900s
Historical Development: The game evolved from traditional card games in the region
Cultural Significance: Popular social and family game

Four players (or five with one sitting out per deal). Play is anticlockwise. Teams are one vs three or two vs two, determined by bidding; in two vs two the bidder calls a tarok (usually XIX) and its holder becomes the declarer's partner.
